company_overview: Google is a technology company that develops a broad range of AI products and services, including the Gemini family of large language models, Search, Workspace, Cloud, and Developer platforms. Its latest Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber models are positioned to deliver next-generation intelligence for agentic workflows and cybersecurity.
target_audience: Consumers seeking AI-powered search and productivity assistants; businesses using Google Ads, Cloud, and Workspace; developers, researchers, and startups building on Google AI, DeepMind, and developer tooling (e.g., agentic workflows and cybersecurity).

company_overview: Meta (formerly Facebook) is a social technology company that operates social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and Threads, as well as hardware products including Meta Quest VR headsets and Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses. The company is notable for its focus on advancing artificial intelligence, virtual/mixed reality technologies, and its mission to build the future of human connection.
target_audience: General consumers worldwide seeking social connection, entertainment, and mixed reality experiences; plus advertising partners and developers building on Meta's platforms.

company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform for engineers and enterprises to design, build, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services across the full API lifecycle. It is widely adopted as the platform where the world's APIs are built and shipped, now integrating native AI capabilities such as an AI Engineer, Agent Mode, and MCP servers to automate API workflows and accelerate development at scale.
target_audience: Software engineers, development teams, and enterprises building, testing, and managing APIs and AI-powered services at scale.

company_overview: Supabase provides a complete, open-source backend platform built around Postgres, bundling authentication, real-time data, storage, edge functions, and vector embeddings into a single developer service. It differentiates itself by offering an integrated dashboard and ready-made starter templates that let developers ship production applications quickly without managing multiple infrastructure components.
target_audience: Developers building full-stack web and mobile applications (React, Next.js, Flutter, React Native) who need a scalable Postgres-powered backend with authentication, storage, and AI/vector capabilities.

company_overview: Resend is an email infrastructure platform that enables developers to deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale through a developer-first API, SDKs, and a React-based visual editor. Notable for its "developer experience" focus, it powers email templates via the open-source react-email library and is trusted by companies of all sizes for high-deliverability email sending.

company_overview: Sentry is an error monitoring and performance monitoring platform that helps developers and software teams identify, debug, and fix code issues in real time, with connected logs, replays, and AI-assisted debugging. It stands out for its developer-first approach—minimal five-line SDK setup, a single unified trace across all signals, and AI features like Seer that auto-generate merge-ready patches and review code.
target_audience: Developers and software engineering teams building applications across web, mobile, and backend platforms (Next.js, React, Python, Node.js, .NET, Swift, etc.)
